content.title: A market-initialised accelerated failure time model for in-play football forecasting
content.abstract: In-play football forecasting models are rarely compared with betting exchange prices, which aggregate information from many market participants. We make this comparison for several goal-arrival models, focusing on a Weibull accelerated failure time model with two extensions: initialising team strength parameters from Betfair Exchange prices at kick-off to capture pre-match market information, and including cumulative shots as a time-varying covariate to capture in-play information.
